landing.stepsTitle: From script to order calls, all in one place

steps.title: Script
steps.body: Just enter your product and price. AI writes a promo script with lines and shot directions for each section.

steps.title: Video
steps.body: With Lite, film the script on your phone and upload it. With Premium, AI makes the promo video for you, no filming needed.

steps.title: Short-form
steps.body: AI picks the 3 moments that make people want to buy, cuts them, and adds hooks and captions in your customers' languages.

steps.title: Phone answering
steps.body: Write answers to common questions and get your shop's own 070 number. Calls are answered by AI salesperson “Tije.”

steps.title: Add QR & number
steps.body: Add a QR code for your product site and your order phone number to your long and short videos.

steps.title: Post to social
steps.body: Post to your connected Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok all at once, with a product link in the caption.

landing.edgesTitle: We don't stop at cutting clips

edges.title: AI that explains why it picked each scene
edges.body: Reasons, not scores. Like “The cheese and the price show up together, so this is when buying desire peaks,” so you can choose with confidence.

edges.title: Hooks in your customers' languages, all at once
edges.body: Get copy for the same scene in the languages of the countries you pick: USA, Japan, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand, and Korea. Reach traveling tourists right away.

edges.title: Can't film? AI makes it for you
edges.body: With Premium, just pick a template and upload photos. AI makes a promo video from your script with your own face avatar, an AI persona of your choice, or just your product.

edges.title: Calls to the number in your clips go to AI salesperson “Tije”
edges.body: When viewers call the number in your short, Tije takes the order in their language and even texts an order confirmation. You just run your shop.

faqs.q: What if I can't edit video at all?
faqs.a: No problem. Just upload a video filmed from the script. AI transcribes it, picks the scenes, and adds the copy. No editing software needed.

faqs.q: I don't speak English. Can I still serve foreign customers?
faqs.a: Yes. AI writes your short-form hooks and captions in your customers' languages, and AI salesperson Tije takes phone orders in their language. You just check everything in your own language.

Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Vietnamese, and Thai. We create copy for customers from the USA, Korea, Japan, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, and Thailand, and this site is available in the same 7 languages.
Go with Premium. Pick a template, upload product photos, and AI makes a promo video from your script. Want to use your own face? Just upload a face photo and a short video too.

faqs.q: Is an AI video made with my face OK?
faqs.a: We only use photos and videos you've consented to, and finished videos are labeled “AI-generated.” If you'd rather not use your face, choose the AI persona or product-only template.

faqs.q: How do I start phone answering?
faqs.a: Write down common customer questions and answers (AI can draft them for you), and you'll get your shop's own 070 number. Put it in your videos, and AI salesperson Tije answers the calls.

faqs.q: Does it post to Instagram and YouTube automatically?
faqs.a: Connect your accounts and we'll post to Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok all at once. Instagram caption links aren't clickable, so we guide customers with the QR code and phone number in the video.
Nope. It's month to month, and you can cancel anytime. Try a sample and your own product before you pay.
